notes: Answered strictly from documented public biography of Elizabeth Taylor (b. 27 Feb 1932, Heathwood, Hampstead, London; d. 23 Mar 2011, Los Angeles). No chart, horoscope or planetary reasoning used; no verdict/reading fixtures opened; no code run. Key sourcing choices: A1/A2 - the widely circulated 2:30 AM time traces to family recollection, not a hospital or certificate record, so family_memory + round_hour (half-hour figure); A3 unknown because no documented rectification. A4/A5/A34 reflect her extensively documented ~70-100 hospitalisations and many operations (spinal surgeries, 1961 emergency tracheotomy after near-fatal pneumonia, 1968 hysterectomy, 1997 benign brain-tumour surgery, two hip replacements, 1983 and 1988 Betty Ford stays). A6 lists only body areas with a repeated documented record. A10 'distant' for Francis Taylor (art dealer, drank heavily, emotionally remote per major biographies) versus A12 'close' for Sara Taylor, the controlling stage mother. A14/A15: MGM's studio schooling, high-school diploma 1950 - interrupted but completed. A22 'significant': Mike Todd's estate and very large gifts/jewellery. A24 'divorced': her last marriage (Larry Fortensky) ended in divorce in 1996 and she did not remarry. A28 counts Michael Jr (1953), Christopher (1955), Liza (1957) and adopted Maria; A29 'yes' for the difficult pregnancies and the 1968 hysterectomy that ended childbearing. A32 'strong': conversion to Judaism, 1959. A36 is not meaningful for a subject who died in 2011 - answered 'same' as the least misleading available option rather than left blank. A35 is capped at the 12-row maximum, so it carries five of the eight marriages plus the 1939 emigration, one child's birth, Mike Todd's death (March 1958), the Burton divorce and three of the major illness episodes; the omitted marriages are Michael Wilding (Feb 1952), the Burton remarriage (Oct 1975) and John Warner (Dec 1976). Part D (post-reading feedback) is deliberately left unanswered: this was a biography-only exercise and no reading was viewed, so any answer there would be fabricated.
